title: Record the Windows x86_64 gate run of the published core v0.21.62 (evidence, not a qualification)
goal: v0.21.62 (tag commit 7b2a5e7c3, qualified commit bbe19d72d) was qualified on Linux x86_64 and owes Windows x86_64. Every release gate was run on Windows on the tag commit with the recorded commands, under a throwaway HOME/USERPROFILE/APPDATA/SUSI_HOME. The tests gate did not exit 0, so this is evidence toward the owed platform and Windows stays owed for v0.21.62.

failed_tests.cause: method: the gates ran on the tag commit, which adds releases/qualification/v0.21.62.json; the release record lands on main afterwards. release-qualify runs this gate on the qualified commit, where it does not apply. Not a product or platform defect.
intermittent scratch-folder collision on Windows (1 run in 6 alone); fixed on main by T-CLAUDEWINFLAKE-1, not in v0.21.62.

results.environment_note: Two tests (paths_probe env_port_offset_defaults_to_zero_under_isolated_env, integration_tests test_substrate_bootstrap_and_config) read the operator's live daemon when one runs at a non-zero port offset on the host; they pass under a throwaway home, which this run used.

limitations: Windows x86_64 remains owed for v0.21.62: the tests gate must exit 0 on the qualified commit. The next release cut from main carries the fix and can be qualified on Windows.

A separate Windows-first cut of v0.21.62 from its release line (refs/candidates/release/v0.21.62 at 5436c616c) passed every gate (5702 tests, 0 failed) but could not be published: the Linux cut was published first under the same version. T-CLAUDEONECUT-1 prevents that collision from now on.
